snippet.title: Wild Wild Eden - Early Access Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

After your home planet is destroyed, you land on an uncharted world to climb mountains, dive into the sea, and build bases almost anywhere, even on top of waterfalls or inside volcanoes. Tame and ride wild beasts, or use a deep breeding system to raise one-of-a-kind companions in this anime-styled survival crafting RPG. From Magnus Games Studio and Shueisha Games, it heads to Steam Early Access in spring 2027
